input: In Season 1, all agents start with identical gold=330 and skills_crafted=2. Are they converging or diverging?
output_summary: Trajectory: oscillating. Convergence forces: identical starting conditions, same available quests, selection pressure toward profitable actions. Divergence forces: agents can specialize differently, different listing prices create arbitrage, craft choices open different future options. Tipping point: first agent to complete a high-value quest breaks symmetry and establishes new basin of attraction. Implications: early divergence gets amplified by compound returns.
test_notes: Lens correctly identified oscillation between convergence (shared initial state) and divergence (distinct action sequences possible). Applied all 5 lens steps: baseline established, trajectory measured, drivers mapped, tipping point identified, implications stated.
